BEL — MACD + Stochastic RSI Delivery Buys, 4 Strategies (23 Oct 2023 – 9 Jun 2026)

On this page

  1. 1. The rules
  2. 2. Result (net P&L after FYERS charges)
  3. 3. Lesson

Delivery buys only (same-day sells allowed), FYERS charges only (no slippage), ₹1,00,000 per trade, all timeframes. Education, not investment advice. Every trade (buy/sell time and price, qty, each FYERS charge, MACD/signal/histogram, %K/%D): ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/BEL_DELIVERY_BUYS_REPORT.md and reports/bel_delivery/trades_all.csv. Same idea tested earlier on ADANIPORTS / Nifty 50: adaniports_macd_stoch_backtest.md.

1. The rules

Common to all four. On the same candle:

  • the Stoch RSI blue line (%K) crosses above the orange line (%D): previous candle blue ≤ orange, this candle blue > orange
  • the MACD histogram is bigger than on the previous candle (green or red bar)

→ buy at that candle's close. Sell at the close of the first later candle where blue meets orange (blue ≤ orange). No stop-loss. Settings MACD 12/26/9, Stoch RSI 3/3/14/14.

StrategyMACD line and signal lineBlue at the cross
1both > 0below 50
2anywherebelow 50
3both > 0below 70
4anywherebelow 70

FYERS charges: held overnight ≈ ₹284 (0.28%) per ₹1L round trip; sold the same day ≈ ₹83 (0.08%, intraday rates). 15-min and 30-min data only start on 1 Dec 2025, so those two cover Dec 2025 – 9 Jun 2026.

BEL buy-and-hold over the same window: about +210% (1-hour/4-hour/daily) and −0.8% (15/30-min, Dec 2025 – Jun 2026).

Is it real? Random buys held for the same number of candles also make money, because BEL tripled. So each result is compared with 500 random-buy runs:

4-hour 14-hour 24-hour 34-hour 4Daily 1Daily 2Daily 3Daily 4
Beats % of random runs77%89%81%82%78%77%75%82%
Net without the best 3 trades−₹13.1k+₹19.8k−₹10.1k+₹13.1k−₹19.6k+₹62−₹19.6k+₹5.2k
  • 15-min, 30-min and 1-hour lose with every strategy. Most of those trades are sold the same day, and the move is ≈ 0.0–0.14%, while charges are 0.12–0.20%.
  • 4-hour and daily make money with every strategy. But that's mostly BEL rising: only Strategy 2 on 4-hour stays clearly positive without its best 3 trades (+₹19.8k), makes money in 2023, 2024 and 2025 (−₹5.6k in 2026), and beats 89% of random runs. Daily profits come almost entirely from a few 2024 trades.
  • 70 instead of 50 adds about 10–25% more trades. It helped on 1-hour (losses got smaller) but made 4-hour slightly worse. On daily, Strategy 3 gave exactly the same 24 trades as Strategy 1.
  • The MACD > 0 filter (1, 3) cuts trades by more than half, and the profit with them. In Strategy 1, 223 of 258 buys came on a red but shrinking histogram: a Stoch cross after a pullback usually comes while MACD is still below its signal line.

3. Lesson

On BEL, only the slower timeframes make the trades long enough (about 3–4 candles = 1–2 days on 4-hour) to cover the 0.28% delivery charges. Strategy 2 on 4-hour (histogram bigger than previous + blue crosses orange below 50) is the best lead. It's still one stock in a strongly rising market, and 89% is below the usual 95% bar. Next: test Strategy 2 / 4 on 4-hour across all Nifty 50 stocks, and add a stop-loss. The 4 Jun 2024 election-day crash (−18.7% in one trade) shows what can happen without one.
